'''Nars''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Nars system/Legends|Nars system]] of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. A [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked it to the [[Knores system/Legends|Knores system]].<ref name="TEA" />

A pale and [[Temperature/Legends|chilly]] planet, Nars was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Nartian]] [[Species/Legends|species]], members of which were ubiquitous as servants throughout the Senex-Juvex. Every Nartian was expected to make a pilgrimage to Nars at least once in their life, which elderly Nartians often did by spending a major portion of their accumulated [[Currency/Legends|wealth]].<ref name="TEA" />

Like the rest of the region's worlds, Nars was under the control of the [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[Ancient Houses]]. The planet also shared its name with the Nartian festival known as the [[Nars Week]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nars was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-17.<ref name="TEA" />
